hook.line: Top 3 SEO opportunities in 2024 - focus on these three to dominate search.
hook.visual: Seated presenter in a white knit sweater on a dark topo background; a big glowing 'SEO' word and green rising line appear behind his head, cash pile slides in.

beats.what: List promise spoken while 'SEO' title text and a green growth line sit behind his head
Opportunity 1: a red X slashes across a ChatGPT logo behind him ('don't let AI write')
Survey bar chart card pops in over his chest as proof
Zoom punch-in on the face as he lands the human-vs-AI ranking stat
Huge '94.12%' with a green up arrow and a cut-out writer photo fills the top of frame
Opportunity 2: a glowing US map appears for 'SEO outside of English'
His own analytics table by country slides up as evidence
Cut to a tighter take: use ChatGPT to translate, a human to localise
Opportunity 3: a highlighted long-tail keyword definition card above his head
Cut to the final take naming a keyword tool; ends mid-thought so it loops

why_it_works: Numbered list ('opportunity #1, #2, #3') tells the viewer how much is left, so they stay for the last item
Every claim is backed within seconds by a pop-up chart, analytics table or big stat, which reads as proof rather than opinion
Contrarian first point ('don't let AI write your content') against the crowd's habit creates tension in an AI-heavy feed
Graphics appear behind and around the head while the face stays centred, so the talking head is never hidden
weaknesses: Almost no cuts (first at 54 s), so the middle relies entirely on pop-up graphics to hold attention
Visual density drops in the last third: mostly bare face from 56 s on
No explicit call to action; the video cuts off mid-sentence
for_robert: Put the proof object (chart, number, logo with a red X) behind his head at the moment he says the claim; Fred could slap the same red X on a logo instead of a static graphic.
